title: Github depreciation of actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-java@v4
symptom: GitHub Actions reports incoming deprecation of actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-java@v4 in the aaps-ci.yml file, causing warnings in action runs.
cause: The aaps-ci.yml file uses deprecated versions of actions/checkout and actions/setup-java.
fix: Update aaps-ci.yml to use actions/checkout@v6 and actions/setup-java@v5, as suggested by the issue author and confirmed by a commit in the dev branch.
evidence_quote: aaps-ci.yml file should be updated to actions/checkout@v6 and actions/setup-java@v5. That worked for my personal action.
